name: em_furniture_and_interior
description: EM Furniture and Interior - E-commerce Web Application (MVP)

scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix backend & npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test:visual: npm --prefix frontend run build && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.js visual.spec.js
scripts.test:visual:update: npm --prefix frontend run build && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.js visual.spec.js --update-snapshots=all
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix frontend run build && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.js
